caption:
Your credit card travel insurance probably does not qualify for Schengen.

Travel insurance and Schengen-compliant medical insurance are not the same thing. The requirement is specific: a minimum medical coverage amount, valid across all Schengen states, covering your entire stay including repatriation.

Fail one condition and it is a technical rejection — before anyone reads your cover letter.
